S1.name: Spectral Axe
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with an axe, inflicting injuries proportional to damage dealt (up to 10% of max Health). Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health. A critical hit will heal the caster.

S2.name: Passive: Combat Frenzy
S2.description: After being attacked, increases the caster's Combat Readiness by 8%. When an ally dies, resets the cooldown of Deliverance: Soul Exchange and grants the caster the War God buff. War God increases Defense penetration of Deliverance: Soul Exchange by 50%. Dispelled after attacking.

S3.name: Deliverance: Soul Exchange
S3.description: Attacks the enemy with divine judgment. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health. When the enemy is defeated, revives one random dead ally with 30% Health and 100% Combat Readiness. When the caster has War God, penetrates the target's Defense by 50%.

S1.name: Eliminating Variables
S1.description: Attacks the enemy by eliminating unnecessary variables. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Speed.

S2.name: Laying the Groundwork
S2.description: Dispels one debuff from an ally before granting increased Attack (Greater) to the caster. When the target has the Target debuff, grants an extra turn to the caster.

S3.name: Eliminating the Target
S3.description: Attacks all enemies by calculating the optimal route, and penetrates Defense by 80%. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Speed. Inflicts Extinction when the enemy is defeated.

S1.name: Overwhelming Dominance
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with overwhelming dominance, with a 75% chance to decrease Hit Chance for 1 turn. A critical hit increases damage dealt.

S2.name: Supreme Authority
S2.description: At the start of the first battle, increases the caster's Combat Readiness by 30%, and is immune to Combat Readiness reduction effects. When it is not the caster's turn, when an enemy uses a non-attack skill, decreases their Combat Readiness by 30%.

S3.name: Kneel Before Me
S3.description: After dispelling all buffs from all enemies, attacks with dark magic, absorbing 40% of damage dealt as Health. This skill is activated even when the caster is unable to use a skill.

S1.name: Tempest
S1.description: Rapidly attacks the enemy, with a 35% chance to decrease Defense for 2 turns. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Speed and penetrates Defense by 20%.

S2.name: Mental Focus
S2.description: Grants immunity to all allies for 2 turns, before granting Skill Nullifier to the caster.

S3.name: Instant Blade
S3.description: Attacks all enemies with a sword, dispelling two buffs before a 85% chance (100% when awakened) to inflict Frostbite and Restrict for 2 turns. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Speed.

S1.name: Exposed Vulnerability
S1.description: Attacks the enemy, increasing both Hit Chance and Critical Hit Chance by 50% when attacking.

S2.name: Elaborate Plan
S2.description: Dispels all debuffs from a single ally, before increasing their Combat Readiness by 30%. Grants increased Attack (Greater) and increased Hit Chance to the caster for 3 turns.

S3.name: Dragon's Descent
S3.description: Attacks the enemy with the power of the Dragon King. Damage dealt increases proportional to the target's max Health. This attack always results in a critical hit, and cannot trigger a counterattack.

S1.name: Rapid Fire
S1.description: Rapidly fires at the enemy. Damage dealt increases proportional to the target's max Health. A Critical Hit grants two Focus. Otherwise, grants one Focus.

S2.name: Explosive Cavalier
S2.description: At the start of the first battle, gains 3 Focus. When Focus is fully charged, consumes it all before taking another turn. When an ally lands a Critical Hit, grants 1 Focus to the caster.

S3.name: Rifle Shot
S3.description: Attacks the enemy with a rifle shot, increasing Combat Readiness of all allies by 15%. When Focus is fully charged, consumes all Focus to increase damage dealt and ignore Effect Resistance.

S1.name: Swift Cut
S1.description: Attacks the enemy with the sword of vengeance, before recovering Health. Amount recovered increases proportional to the caster's max Health.

S2.name: Blade of Vengeance
S2.description: When more than one enemy is alive, at the start of the caster's turn, gain 1 stack of Grudge (max 5 stacks). Additional damage dealt (up to 1,500 per stack, max 7,500) increases proportional to number of Grudge stacks. At the start of the first battle, gains 5 stacks of Grudge.

S3.name: Punishment Strike
S3.description: Attacks all enemies with an aura of vengeance, with a 75% chance to make them unhealable for 2 turns, before granting immunity to the caster for 3 turns.
